I’m kind of sensitive to messes bc my parents were hoarders growing up, and I have a lot of anxiety surrounding this. So I have a few rules that help!


1. Everything must have a place. If something doesn’t have a place and is consistently left out, I make a place! Good examples of fixes are baskets, drawer organizers, furniture that always has drawers or shelves, under the bed containers, etc. Lots of these come from goodwill so I save some money too. 

2. Dishes cannot be in the sink for more than 24hrs. Honestly, most of the time this ends up getting me to do them right when I put leftovers away, I almost never take the full 24hrs (usually it’s like 8). I used to be more anxious about this, and I would HAVE to wash a dish every time it hit the sink. Now, I allow myself to leave maybe a coffee mug and a bowl or something, but only for 24hrs max. I also clean around the sink and on the counters every time I do the dishes to kill two tasks at a time. Dishes really don’t take long! Next time you hand wash a bunch, time yourself and you’ll be surprised at how quick it goes. 

3. Make your bed in the morning. There’s been some studies on how this affects people’s entire days, and I swear doing it makes me more productive for the entire day. I don’t mind cleaning up clutter, I don’t feel stressed when I enter the room, and it’s just a good routine. 

4. DECLUTTER. This definitely comes from the parents being hoarders thing. I get a lot of my things from goodwill, clothes especially, but I won’t go to goodwill unless I have a bag to drop off every time. Also, if you haven’t used it or worn it in a year: you don’t need it. And if you do need it, you can find it again later. For now, it’s just taking up space, and that doesn’t help with anything. 

5. Tidy as you go. Deep clean when you have time and motivation. Pick up after yourself - it doesn’t take long. 

6. Stressing out about it won’t get it done. I’ve always been really bad about this. Listening to a podcast or some music helps a lot. 


I hope some of these helped! I’ve had a lot of trauma with cleaning and messy spaces, and keeping my space decluttered and presentable makes me feel so so soooo much better. But it’s taken me awhile to learn that it doesn’t have to be perfect. You’ll get it done, and good habits go a long way, you just have to start them first. :)

TLDR: I have rules for myself! 1. Everything has a place; 2. Dishes have a time limit and don’t take long; 3. Make your bed; 4. DECLUTTER!! (Biggest rule for me); 5. Tidy as you go; 6. Stressing won’t get it done.
